zh-Hant.title: 出問題時，點一下就能告訴我們
zh-Hant.body: 逐字稿是空的或只轉到一半、錄音一直同步不上去、錄音時麥克風反覆中斷，Parley 會在當下問你要不要回報，點一下就把診斷資料傳給我們，不含錄音或逐字稿內容。
zh-Hant.also: 截圖時可以直接回報這個畫面；當機報告預設自動傳送，可在「回饋與診斷」關閉。

en.title: When something breaks, tell us in one tap
en.body: An empty or cut-short transcript, a recording that won't sync, a microphone that kept dropping: Parley asks right then whether to report it, and one tap sends the diagnostics, never your recordings or transcripts.
en.also: Take a screenshot to report that screen. Crash reports are sent automatically; turn that off under Feedback & diagnostics.
